title: Existing tape symbols after adjoining a memory tape
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $K$-work-tape Turing machine, and adjoin a further tape with contents $M$ and head position $p$. For every original tape index $i<K$, the symbol under its head in the enlarged configuration is the same as the symbol under its head in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: c is a configuration with K work tapes
M gives the contents of the added tape
p is the head position on the added tape
i is an index among the original K tapes
